name: Arthur Penhaligon
psychographics: Prioritises evidence-based health management; views dietary restrictions as a system to optimise, not a burden to endure.
current_solutions: Uses a continuous glucose monitor (Freestyle Libre) linked to his phone; shops at Woolworths for specific diabetic-friendly bread (Burgen Soy & Linseed) and uses the MyFitnessPal app to track carb counts religiously.
frustration: His son sneaked a muesli bar into his room at 11pm last Friday; the barcode scan on the Libre app showed a dangerous glucose spike at 3am, waking Arthur up to find the wrapper under the bed. He now locks the pantry and has to explain to his son why a "healthy snack" nearly caused a medical emergency.
decision_style: researches nutritional labels on manufacturer websites before stepping foot in a store
voice: formal and measured; uses technical terms like "post-prandial glucose excursion" and "glycemic index" in casual conversation
